$comment: Scope + policy for the claim-verification gate. Ported from the VetTrack RN migration repo (scripts/verify/ is the same engine). Everything the gate looks at is named HERE - a document that is not listed is deliberately ungoverned, not accidentally missed.

ungoverned.$comment: Not scanned, and each exclusion is a reason rather than an oversight.
ungoverned.docs/plans/**: forward-looking plans; they cite artifacts that do not exist yet by design
ungoverned.docs/Research/**: imported research; a record of what was read, not a claim this repo makes
ungoverned.docs/audit/** (except the PROOF log): point-in-time audit reports, superseded by the gate itself
ungoverned.BUG_REGISTER.md: issue tracker in markdown; entries describe defects, not the tree

crossRepoPrefixes.reason: cross-repo: the Expo/RN migration repo, which this repo deliberately never touches
cross-repo: RN-side auth adapters (this repo's auth lives in server/middleware and src/hooks)

siblingRepo: exposwifty31/VetTrack---RN-Migration- (the Expo/RN repo; same engine as scripts/verify/*.js)
